main_text.p: SimilaresSimilares quæ unam & eandem omnino habent substantiam: & quia propriis vocabulis pleræq; carent, analogia quadam ex animalium partibus appellationem mutuantur.
Hæ sunt vel Liquidæ vel Solidæ.
Succi.Succus est pars liquida, in ipsis stirpium substantiis diffusa, quæ quasi sanguis earum conservat vitam.
Lacryma.Lacryma sunt humores, qui ex plantis sua sponte exeuntes, vel Solis calore eductì, vel copia expressi, vel ab ipsis plantis aliqua occasione dehiscentibus expulsi.
Gummi.Resina.Suntque vel Aquea ut quæ in gummi concrescunt: vel Picea quæ in resinam coeunt.
Planta, Caro.Caro est crassior stirpis substantia, constans ex humore concreto, musculis animalium respondens.
Fibra.Fibræ sunt partes crassiores continuæ, fissiles, quæ eodem modo in plantam universam feruntur, quo venæ & nervi in animalibus, quorum exemplo hæ quoq; in plantis, aliæ venæ, aliæ nervi appel-

page.notes: Right-margin notes are small and partly cut off; "Similares", "Succi.", "Lacryma.", "Gummi.", "Resina.", "Planta", "Caro.", "Fibra.", and a last partly illegible note near the bottom are read with doubt. The line "Suntque vel Aquea ut quæ in gummi" is read as printed. Word "appel-" at the foot is a catchword-style hyphenated break and is kept in the text. Printed text at the foot "O 5" is a signature mark and is not transcribed as text. The line "Caro est crassior" and the phrase "ex plantis sua sponte exeuntes" are uncertain at the scan's edge.
